n82cad11b1c.headline: Oil tops $100 after Russian assault on Ukraine
n82cad11b1c.summary: Brent North Sea crude topped $100 per barrel on Thursday for the first time in more than seven years, following the Russian assault on Ukraine.
n82cad11b1c.why: Brent is the main global benchmark for crude oil, so geopolitical supply risks in producing regions feed directly into fuel, transport and inflation costs.
n82cad11b1c.why_moved: The Russian assault on Ukraine raised fears of supply disruption from a major oil producer, pushing Brent above $100 per barrel.

nba8cbf004a.headline: Circle Launches New Account to Facilitate Runnig Business with USDC
nba8cbf004a.summary: Circle has launched the Circle Account, which will let businesses use US dollar coin (USDC) through Circle APIs. The product aims to bring USDC payments into business operations.
nba8cbf004a.why: Circle issues USDC, a dollar-pegged stablecoin, so its product launches affect the adoption and use of stablecoins in payments.

n6d4ae3bb6f.headline: Marchers tell Godongwana: ‘We are hungry. Our pots are empty’
n6d4ae3bb6f.summary: Hundreds marched through Cape Town's city centre on Wednesday, calling on Finance Minister Enoch Godongwana to find urgent solutions to high unemployment.
n6d4ae3bb6f.why: South Africa's unemployment rate is a central fiscal and political concern, shaping government spending and economic policy choices.

n9ae0ac0315.headline: What’s happing to workers as the UK oil and gas industry decarbonises?
n9ae0ac0315.summary: The UK oil and gas industry is addressing recruitment and skills problems as it decarbonises, according to Offshore Energies UK and other sources cited by Offshore Technology. The article covers workforce change.
n9ae0ac0315.why: The UK North Sea is a major oil and gas producing region, and workforce constraints can affect output and the pace of the energy transition.

nc3d980df1d.headline: ECB 'closely monitoring' implications of Ukraine invasion
nc3d980df1d.summary: The European Central Bank said it is closely monitoring the implications of the Russian invasion of Ukraine. The bank said it was following unfolding events.
nc3d980df1d.why: The European Central Bank sets interest rates and monetary policy for the euro area, so its response to shocks influences euro bond yields and the currency.

na0a3a6bf03.headline: 'Credible but cautious': Alberta budget out of red; forecasts rosy economic future
na0a3a6bf03.summary: Alberta's budget is out of deficit, with forecasts for a strong economic outlook and increased spending on hospitals and health care. Officials described the budget as credible but cautious.
na0a3a6bf03.why: Alberta is Canada's main energy-producing province, so its fiscal position is closely tied to oil and gas revenues and provincial borrowing.

ncb1a6d042f.headline: How the U.S. benefits when China turns its back on Bitcoin
ncb1a6d042f.summary: Most cryptocurrency mining took place in China until authorities shut it down. Chinese bitcoin miners have since moved equipment to US towns including Kearney, Nebraska.
ncb1a6d042f.why: Bitcoin mining uses large amounts of computing power and electricity, so the location of miners affects network hash rate and mining costs.

ned12dc62f3.headline: Opera Announces Integration with Ethereum Layer 2 Exchange DeversiFi
ned12dc62f3.summary: Opera announced an integration with Ethereum layer 2 exchange DeversiFi. The Web3 browser will offer a layer 2 Ethereum wallet to its customers.
ned12dc62f3.why: Layer 2 networks process Ethereum transactions more cheaply, and browser-based wallets are a growing channel for crypto users.

nd0f503303b.headline: Regulating short-term lets could see rents ‘plateau’, says property expert
nd0f503303b.summary: A letting agent said licensing Airbnb-style short-term lets could push landlords into the private rental market and see rents plateau. The comments concern UK housing rules.
nd0f503303b.why: Short-term let rules change the supply of rental housing, which affects rents and property returns for landlords.

na33b8f89f6.headline: BNY Mellon Partners Chainalysis to Keep Track of Its Customers' Crypto Transactions
na33b8f89f6.summary: The Bank of New York Mellon has partnered with blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis to improve its risk management program, including tracking customers' crypto transactions.
na33b8f89f6.why: BNY Mellon is one of the largest custody and securities-servicing banks in the world, so its adoption of crypto compliance tools signals growing institutional involvement in digital assets.

nf257d7d9a4.headline: Fuel prices soar as Russia invades Ukraine - will it affect the UK?
nf257d7d9a4.summary: Fuel prices have risen sharply following Russia's invasion of Ukraine. The report questions the effect on the UK, noting Russia is the world's second-largest oil producer and a major supplier to Europe.
nf257d7d9a4.why: Russia is one of the largest global oil and gas producers, so disruptions to its exports feed directly into global crude and European energy prices.
nf257d7d9a4.why_moved: The input links the invasion of Ukraine to a sharp rise in fuel prices and notes Russia's position as a major oil supplier to Europe.

n2566a74cf1.headline: Senate Democrats want to fight inflation, but there are limits to what they can do
n2566a74cf1.summary: Senate Democrats are looking at a gas tax holiday to bring relief to consumers facing skyrocketing prices, though there are limits to what they can do on inflation.
n2566a74cf1.why: Fiscal measures such as fuel tax changes influence consumer prices and the inflation outlook that drives Federal Reserve policy.

n87905a4b9f.headline: Why RBI is cautious in rolling out the Central Bank Digital Currency

n87905a4b9f.why: The Reserve Bank of India is the country's central bank, and its digital rupee decisions affect payments and monetary infrastructure.

n917505bdf2.headline: Russia-Ukraine crisis: Oil price soars past $105 amid fears of supply disruptions
n917505bdf2.summary: Brent crude futures rose more than 8.9% to $105.36 a barrel, while US West Texas Intermediate climbed over 8.7% to $100.10 on fears of supply disruptions.
n917505bdf2.why: Brent and WTI are the main global benchmarks for crude oil, and their prices feed directly into fuel costs, inflation and energy-company earnings.
n917505bdf2.why_moved: Reports of possible supply disruptions tied to the Russia-Ukraine crisis drove a sharp rally in crude futures, per the input.

ne43745ca8c.headline: British Gas guarantees UK energy supplies are safe after Russia invasion
ne43745ca8c.summary: British Gas owner Centrica reported bumper results and guaranteed that UK energy supplies are safe following the Russian invasion. The company declined to comment on likely price increases.
ne43745ca8c.why: Centrica owns British Gas, one of the UK's largest energy suppliers. Its results and pricing signals reflect wholesale gas costs and household energy bills.

nf33b8ab6a9.headline: Fuel prices predicted to hit £1.60 a litre as Russia invades Ukraine
nf33b8ab6a9.summary: Fuel costs in the UK are predicted to reach £1.60 per litre as the Russia-Ukraine conflict pushes oil prices to an eight-year high.
nf33b8ab6a9.why: Rising fuel prices increase inflationary pressures and impact consumer spending and transportation costs in the UK economy.
nf33b8ab6a9.why_moved: Conflict in Eastern Europe raised oil supply risk premiums, driving Brent crude prices and UK fuel costs higher.

n725bbeec00.headline: oil prices: Oil at $103: No fears of supply disruption to India, prices a concern
n725bbeec00.summary: International oil prices surged to over $103 a barrel after Russia attacked Ukraine, though India expects uninterrupted fuel supplies despite inflation concerns.
n725bbeec00.why: Oil prices are sensitive to geopolitical tensions, especially involving major producers like Russia, affecting global inflation and energy markets.
n725bbeec00.why_moved: The Russia-Ukraine war triggered concerns over oil supply disruptions from Russia, a major exporter, causing prices to spike above $103 per barrel.
